title: 第8章 夫君闪亮登场
slug: 江南第一媳全本免费-江南第一媳最新章节列表
content_zh:
这件事就算梁心铭不往上捅，最后也会被大家知道。若真凶就是梁心铭，那他这个县令自然无事；若是冤案，这诬陷科考秀才的罪名他可背不起。梁心铭与他无仇无怨，他何苦为难人家？莫欺少年穷，不如送个人情给梁心铭，将来说不定有大用。
黄县令想，自己也不用做什么，只要拖延着，等乡试结束，主考官王亨脱身出来，再请他和巡抚大人旁听此案，那时不管牵连到谁，都不怕担责任了。
黄县令惯会拖拉扯皮的手段，便虚张声势、查东问西，找些借口敷衍知府大人，逼急了就抬出巡抚大人做挡箭牌；暗地里，他却悄悄卖人情给梁心铭，说：吴知府对你如此这般，都叫本官给拦住了。本官爱惜你是个人才，所以维护你，但你自己也要争气，要想法子澄清冤屈云云。
梁心铭自然要感激他，赞他清正为民。
回家后，她才把脸放下来——好个吴知府！
李惠娘更是扑簌簌直掉泪，哽咽自责道：“这都怪我。若不是我心心念念……”
“好了惠娘！”梁心铭温言拦住她，并警告地瞅了她一眼，目光往门口一扫，坦然道，“我问心无愧，你担心什么？快些去做饭，吃了好歇息。明早还要下场呢。”
李惠娘心中“咯噔”一下，忙不迭擦眼泪，然后去做饭。
这天晚上，梁心铭为谨慎起见，没有洗澡。
她度过了最难受的一晚：胸口已经被捆了三天了，还不得放松，还要打起精神准备明天的考试，还要思考案情……
可是，她会怕吗？
她虽然利用王亨暂时脱身，却绝不会坐等他来救。若连这点突发状况都不能应付，她也别去京城参加会试了，不如恢复女身，和惠娘回乡去。
她从不认为：科举入仕凭借的就是做几篇锦绣文章。
仕途，充满刀光剑影！
次日，梁心铭如愿下场。
她进场了，场外并不平静。
豆腐西施受到反复盘问：梁心铭可曾对她有轻佻举止和言行？并以她家寡母和弱妹来威胁她，让她指证梁心铭。
于是，梁心铭十五日一出场，又被衙役带走。
这次，她是被带到徽州府衙，此案已经从歙县县衙移交到徽州府了。因为案情涉及乡试学子，林巡抚很重视，和徽州布政使、徽州按察使亲临现场听审，黄县令也在。
这可算是地方的三司会审。

梁心铭上堂，不等吴知府发问，便先发制人，对案情指出几条新的证据和疑点：
其一，她那天清晨经过渔梁街时，有人从头到尾一直看见她，可以为她作证：她并未进入过小巷杀人。
其二，凶犯留在毒老虎身上的丝帕，乃是贵重之物，非她一介贫寒书生能用得起；那头巾和裙子的布料虽然是棉布，也都是新的，也不是梁家能随便置办出来的；还有刺杀毒老虎的凶器，不是菜刀而是匕首，她如何能有？
其三，案发以来，官府将所有目光都集中在跟豆腐西施相关的人身上，似乎认定是情杀，为什么不去查证毒老虎的仇家？或许就是毒老虎的仇人杀人灭口呢！
其四，凶手在巷子内杀人后，到底是从什么地方出巷子的？巷子东头有小厮守着，那只有西头了。若是从西头出去的，便不能在预定的时间回到渔梁街来，又怎么能跟她扯上关系呢？她可是从渔梁街去的贡院。
其五，“捉贼拿脏，捉奸拿双”，说她和豆腐西施有私情，纯属子虚乌有；说她和豆腐西施合谋杀人，在什么地方合谋？什么时候合谋？都什么人看见？
她从容镇定，侃侃而谈，堂上众位大人都有种错觉：她完全有能力破获这案子，可是她不愿卷入此事，因此只想洗清自己，有些话说得很含蓄；若是逼得她没了退路，她定会出手，揪出真凶，到那时……
吴知府嘴角抽搐，竭力忍住，喝道：“带证人！”
公堂外，李惠娘和一个汉子正等着，闻言忙作揖道：“劳烦大哥了。”那汉子忙道：“不用客气。”便进了公堂，
汉子上堂供称：那天早上，他的确在渔梁街上和梁心铭同路，因为梁心铭长得实在出众，给他留下深刻印象。梁心铭原本走在他前面，慢悠悠的一边走一边看风景，就落到他后面去了。但是，他几次回头，发现梁心铭都跟在他后面，绝不可能有空闲换女装去杀人，然后再跑回来。

content_en:
Even if Liang Xinming didn't reveal this matter, everyone would eventually know about it. If the real culprit is Liang Xinming, then he, the county magistrate, will be fine; if it is an unjust case, he cannot afford to bear the charge of framing a scholar in the scientific examination. Liang Xinming had no grudges against him, so why would he bother others? Don't bully the young man into being poor, why not send a favor to Liang Xinming, it may be of great use in the future.
Magistrate Huang thought that he didn't have to do anything. He just had to delay it until the township examination was over and the examiner Wang Heng came out, and then invited him and the governor to observe the case. By then, no matter who was involved, they would no longer be afraid of taking responsibility.
County magistrate Huang was accustomed to stalling and wrangling, so he bluffed, inquired, and found excuses to deal with the prefect. When pressed, he used the governor as a shield; secretly, he quietly sold favors to Liang Xinming, saying: Prefect Wu did this to you, and I had to stop him. I cherish you as a talented person, so I protect you, but you also have to live up to your expectations and find ways to clear up grievances and so on.
Liang Xinming naturally wanted to be grateful to him and praise him for his integrity and serving the people.
After returning home, she put down her face - what a magistrate Wu!
Li Huiniang burst into tears, choked with sobs and blamed herself: "This is all my fault. If I hadn't been thinking about her..."
"Okay Hui Niang!" Liang Xinming stopped her with gentle words, gave her a warning look, glanced at the door, and said calmly, "I have a clear conscience, what are you worried about? Go cook quickly, eat and have a good rest. We have to leave tomorrow morning."
Li Huiniang's heart skipped a beat and she quickly wiped her tears and went to cook.
That night, Liang Xinming did not take a shower out of caution.
She spent the most uncomfortable night: her chest had been tied for three days, and she still couldn't relax. She still had to brace herself for tomorrow's exam and think about the case...
But, will she be afraid?
Although she used Wang Heng to escape temporarily, she would never wait for him to rescue her. If she couldn't cope with this unexpected situation, she shouldn't go to the capital to take part in the examination. It would be better to regain her female body and go back to her hometown with Huiniang.
She never thought that the only way to become an official in the imperial examination was to write a few beautiful articles.
An official career is full of swords and swords!
The next day, Liang Xinming ended as he wished.
She entered the venue, but it was not peaceful outside.
Tofu Xishi was repeatedly interrogated: Did Liang Xinming ever have frivolous behavior and words towards her? He threatened her with her widowed mother and weak sister and asked her to testify against Liang Xinming.
Therefore, as soon as Liang Xinming appeared on the 15th, he was taken away by the government officials again.
This time, she was taken to the Huizhou government office, and the case had been transferred from Shexian County government office to the Huizhou government office. Because the case involved rural examination students, Governor Lin paid great attention to it and went to the scene to hear the case in person with the Huizhou Chief Envoy and Huizhou Inspector. Huang County Magistrate was also there.
This can be regarded as a local three-division review.
Liang Xinming went to court, and before Magistrate Wu could ask questions, he preemptively pointed out several new pieces of evidence and doubts about the case:
First, when she passed Yuliang Street early that morning, someone saw her from beginning to end, who could testify for her: she had not entered the alley to kill anyone.
Secondly, the silk handkerchief left by the murderer on the poisonous tiger was a valuable thing, and she, a poor scholar, could not afford it. Although the fabrics of the headscarf and skirt were cotton, they were both new and could not be easily purchased by the Liang family. The murder weapon that assassinated the poisonous tiger was not a kitchen knife but a dagger. How could she have it?
Third, since the incident, the government has focused all its attention on the people related to Tofu Xishi, and seems to believe that it was a murder of love. Why not investigate the poisonous tiger's enemies? Maybe it was the poisonous tiger’s enemies who killed and silenced him!
Fourth, after the murderer committed the murder in the alley, where did he come out of the alley? There is a boy guarding the east end of the alley, but there is only the west end. If he went out from the west end, he would not be able to return to Yuliang Street at the scheduled time, so how could he have anything to do with her? She went to Gongyuan from Yuliang Street.
Fifth, "Catch a thief and get dirty, catch an adulterer and get both", saying that she has a relationship with Tofu XishiThe personal relationship is completely false; it is said that she and Tofu Xishi conspired to murder. Where did they conspire? When do you collude? Has anyone seen it?
She spoke calmly and calmly, and all the adults in the hall had the illusion that she was fully capable of solving this case, but she didn't want to get involved, so she just wanted to clear herself. Some of her words were very reserved; if she was forced to have no way out, she would definitely take action and find out the real culprit. By then...
Magistrate Wu's mouth twitched, and he tried his best to hold it back, shouting: "Bring witnesses!"
Outside the court, Li Huiniang and a man were waiting. When she heard this, she hurriedly bowed and said, "Excuse me, brother." The man said hurriedly, "You're welcome." Then he entered the court.
The man went to court and testified that he was indeed walking with Liang Xinming on Yuliang Street that morning because Liang Xinming was really outstanding in appearance and left a deep impression on him. Liang Xinming was walking in front of him, walking slowly while looking at the scenery, and then fell behind him. However, he turned around several times and found that Liang Xinming was following him. There was no way he would have time to change into women's clothing to kill people and then run back.
